added.summary: An anchored TSX element with `occlusion="fade"` draws at 0.35 opacity, and with `"hide"` hides, while a drawn mesh other than its own entity's stands between the camera and its point (a line trace against og.render.raycast's meshes at each tick's end); it carries `data-occluded`. Nameplates and loot labels fade.

Anchored TSX elements with `declutter="stack"` move straight up clear of each other instead of overlapping, and with `"hide"` hide while they overlap; a higher `priority`, then the nearer, keeps its place, and one pushed past the top of the screen hides. Nameplates, loot labels, speech bubbles and interaction prompts (priority 1) stack.

An anchored TSX element with `clamp="edge"` stays on screen when its point leaves it or goes behind the camera: it pins `clampMargin` px (24) inside the edge on the line from the screen's centre toward its point, and carries `data-clamped` and `data-edge-top|right|bottom|left`. Waypoints clamp.
